round: # USE. Reading texts of 60 to 80 words over two or three pages (text only
intro_fa: spoken and lit)
picture: each with questions asking what and why.

round: # Written words as choices are short. Units 10 and 20 are the longer review stories.

intro_fa: لیلا از کار هر نفر فامیل خود می‌گوید. دو صفحه بخوان و به سوال‌ها جواب بده.
say_en: My family's jobs
show_en: My family's jobs

say_en: My name is Laila. There are six people in my family. My father is a farmer. He works in the field every day. My mother is a weaver. She makes beautiful carpets at home.
show_en: My name is Laila. There are six people in my family. My father is a farmer. He works in the field every day. My mother is a weaver. She makes beautiful carpets at home.

say_en: What is her father's job?
show_en: What is her father's job?
wrong_say_fa: نه. دوباره بخوان: My father is a farmer. پدرش دهقان است.

say_en: Where does her mother work?
show_en: Where does her mother work?
wrong_say_fa: نه. مادرش در خانه قالین می‌بافد: She makes carpets at home.

say_en: My big brother is a driver. He drives a lorry to the city. My sister is a nurse at the clinic. My little brother and I do not work. We go to school.
show_en: My big brother is a driver. He drives a lorry to the city. My sister is a nurse at the clinic. My little brother and I do not work. We go to school.

say_en: Who drives a lorry?
show_en: Who drives a lorry?
wrong_say_fa: نه. برادر کلانش دریور است: My big brother is a driver.

say_en: Why do Laila and her little brother not work?
show_en: Why do Laila and her little brother not work?
choices: t:They go to school|t:They are sick|t:It is Friday
wrong_say_fa: نه. آنها هنوز خُرد هستند و به مکتب می‌روند: We go to school.

intro_fa: کاکای کریم نانوا است. بخوان که یک نانوا صبح وقت چه می‌کند، و کریم چطور کمک می‌کند.
say_en: A day at the bakery
show_en: A day at the bakery

say_en: Karim's uncle is a baker. He gets up at four o'clock. People want fresh bread in the morning. First he makes the fire. Then he makes a hundred breads.
show_en: Karim's uncle is a baker. He gets up at four o'clock. People want fresh bread in the morning. First he makes the fire. Then he makes a hundred breads.

say_en: When does the baker get up?
show_en: When does the baker get up?
wrong_say_fa: نه. دوباره بخوان: He gets up at four o'clock. ساعت چهار بیدار می‌شود.

say_en: Why does he get up early?
show_en: Why does he get up early?
choices: t:He is not tired|t:People want bread|t:It is hot
wrong_say_fa: نه. مردم صبح نان تازه می‌خواهند، پس نانوا وقت بیدار می‌شود.

say_en: On Friday Karim helps his uncle. He carries the flour and sells the bread. The bakery smells good. At eight o'clock they are tired, but the customers are happy.
show_en: On Friday Karim helps his uncle. He carries the flour and sells the bread. The bakery smells good. At eight o'clock they are tired, but the customers are happy.

say_en: What does Karim carry?
show_en: What does Karim carry?
wrong_say_fa: نه. کریم آرد را می‌برد: He carries the flour.

say_en: How are the customers?
show_en: How are the customers?
wrong_say_fa: نه. مشتری‌ها خوش هستند: The customers are happy.

intro_fa: سه نفر نزدیک خانه کار می‌کنند: نجار، گلکار و دهقان. در سه صفحه بخوان که کی کجا و با چه کار می‌کند.
say_en: Three workers
show_en: Three workers

say_en: Three people work near my house. The carpenter works in a small workshop. He makes doors and windows with a saw and a hammer.
show_en: Three people work near my house. The carpenter works in a small workshop. He makes doors and windows with a saw and a hammer.

say_en: Who makes doors and windows?
show_en: Who makes doors and windows?
wrong_say_fa: نه. نجار دروازه و کلکین می‌سازد: The carpenter makes doors and windows.

say_en: The builder works outside. He builds a wall with bricks. The farmer works in the field. He has a new tractor. The tractor is loud!
show_en: The builder works outside. He builds a wall with bricks. The farmer works in the field. He has a new tractor. The tractor is loud!

say_en: What does the builder work with?
show_en: What does the builder work with?
wrong_say_fa: نه. گلکار با خشت دیوار می‌سازد: He builds a wall with bricks.

say_en: Where does the farmer work?
show_en: Where does the farmer work?
choices: t:in the workshop|t:in the field|t:at home
wrong_say_fa: نه. دهقان در زمین کار می‌کند: in the field.

say_en: In the evening
show_en: In the evening

say_en: In the evening the three men drink tea together. They talk about their work. They are friends.
show_en: In the evening the three men drink tea together. They talk about their work. They are friends.

say_en: Why do the three men drink tea together?
show_en: Why do the three men drink tea together?
choices: t:They are friends|t:They are sick|t:It is cold
wrong_say_fa: نه. آنها با هم دوست هستند: They are friends.

intro_fa: معلم از صنف می‌پرسد که هر کس می‌خواهد چه کاره شود. دو صفحه بخوان: کی چه می‌خواهد و چرا.
say_en: What do you want to be?
show_en: What do you want to be?

say_en: Today the teacher asks: "What do you want to be?" Nargis says: "I want to be a doctor. I want to help sick children." Yusuf says: "I want to be a mechanic. I like cars."
show_en: Today the teacher asks: "What do you want to be?" Nargis says: "I want to be a doctor. I want to help sick children." Yusuf says: "I want to be a mechanic. I like cars."

say_en: What does Nargis want to be?
show_en: What does Nargis want to be?
wrong_say_fa: نه. نرگس گفت I want to be a doctor: می‌خواهد داکتر شود.

say_en: Why does Yusuf want to be a mechanic?
show_en: Why does Yusuf want to be a mechanic?
choices: t:He likes cars|t:He is strong|t:He is tall
wrong_say_fa: نه. یوسف موترها را خوش دارد: I like cars.

say_en: Shirin says: "I want to be a teacher, like you!" The teacher smiles. She says: "Good. You can be a doctor, a mechanic or a teacher. But first you must learn a lot."
show_en: Shirin says: "I want to be a teacher, like you!" The teacher smiles. She says: "Good. You can be a doctor, a mechanic or a teacher. But first you must learn a lot."

say_en: Who wants to be a teacher?
show_en: Who wants to be a teacher?
wrong_say_fa: نه. شیرین گفت I want to be a teacher, like you: می‌خواهد مثل معلم خود شود.

say_en: What must they do first?
show_en: What must they do first?
choices: t:play a lot|t:learn a lot|t:sleep a lot
wrong_say_fa: نه. معلم گفت But first you must learn a lot: اول باید بسیار درس بخوانید.

intro_fa: فردا جمعه است و فامیل پلان دارد. در دو صفحه بخوان که چه می‌کنند. به going to نگاه کن: از آینده می‌گوید.
say_en: Our plan for Friday
show_en: Our plan for Friday

say_en: Tomorrow is Friday. Our family has a plan. In the morning we are going to visit my aunt and uncle. They live in the next village. It is not far. We are going to walk there.
show_en: Tomorrow is Friday. Our family has a plan. In the morning we are going to visit my aunt and uncle. They live in the next village. It is not far. We are going to walk there.

say_en: Who are they going to visit?
show_en: Who are they going to visit?
wrong_say_fa: نه. دوباره بخوان: We are going to visit my aunt and uncle. به دیدن خاله و کاکا می‌روند.

say_en: Why are they going to walk?
show_en: Why are they going to walk?
choices: t:It is not far|t:It is hot|t:They are late
wrong_say_fa: نه. قریه دور نیست، پس پیاده می‌روند: It is not far.

say_en: My mother is going to bring bread and grapes. My uncle is going to cook rice. After lunch the children are going to play in the garden. I am going to fly my kite!
show_en: My mother is going to bring bread and grapes. My uncle is going to cook rice. After lunch the children are going to play in the garden. I am going to fly my kite!

say_en: Who is going to cook rice?
show_en: Who is going to cook rice?
wrong_say_fa: نه. کاکا برنج می‌پزد: My uncle is going to cook rice.

say_en: What is the child going to do after lunch?
show_en: What is the child going to do after lunch?
wrong_say_fa: نه. او کاغذپران خود را بلند می‌کند: I am going to fly my kite.

intro_fa: هوا بسیار سرد است. علی از خواهرش می‌پرسد که چه خواهد شد. به سوال‌های Is it going to و Are we going to نگاه کن.
say_en: Is it going to snow?
show_en: Is it going to snow?

say_en: It is very cold today. The sky is grey. "Is it going to snow?" asks Ali. "Yes, I think so," says his sister. "Are we going to go to school tomorrow?" asks Ali.
show_en: It is very cold today. The sky is grey. "Is it going to snow?" asks Ali. "Yes, I think so," says his sister. "Are we going to go to school tomorrow?" asks Ali.

say_en: Is it going to snow?
show_en: Is it going to snow?
wrong_say_fa: بلی. خواهرش گفت Yes, I think so: فکر می‌کنم که برف می‌بارد.

say_en: "Yes, we are. But we are not going to walk. Father is going to take us on the donkey cart." Ali is happy. "Then I am going to make a snowman after school!"
show_en: "Yes, we are. But we are not going to walk. Father is going to take us on the donkey cart." Ali is happy. "Then I am going to make a snowman after school!"

say_en: Are they going to walk to school?
show_en: Are they going to walk to school?
wrong_say_fa: نه. خواهرش گفت We are not going to walk: پیاده نمی‌روند.

say_en: Who is going to take them to school?
show_en: Who is going to take them to school?
wrong_say_fa: نه. پدر آنها را با کراچی می‌برد: Father is going to take us.

say_en: Why is Ali happy?
show_en: Why is Ali happy?
wrong_say_fa: نه. علی خوش است چون بعد از مکتب آدم برفی جور می‌کند.

intro_fa: مینا و مادرش هفتهٔ آینده به شهر می‌روند. در سه صفحه بخوان که چطور می‌روند و چرا.
say_en: A trip to the city
show_en: A trip to the city

say_en: Next week Mina and her mother are going to go to the city. Mina's aunt lives there. The city is far.
show_en: Next week Mina and her mother are going to go to the city. Mina's aunt lives there. The city is far.

say_en: Who lives in the city?
show_en: Who lives in the city?
wrong_say_fa: نه. خالهٔ مینا در شهر زندگی می‌کند: Mina's aunt lives there.

say_en: "How are we going to get there?" asks Mina. "By bus," says her mother. "A car is too expensive, and we can't go on foot."
show_en: "How are we going to get there?" asks Mina. "By bus," says her mother. "A car is too expensive, and we can't go on foot."

say_en: How are they going to get there?
show_en: How are they going to get there?
wrong_say_fa: نه. مادر گفت By bus: با بس می‌روند.

say_en: Why don't they go by car?
show_en: Why don't they go by car?
wrong_say_fa: نه. موتر بسیار گران است: A car is too expensive.

say_en: They buy two tickets. A ticket is one hundred afghani. The bus is big and blue. Mina sits at the window. She is going to see the city for the first time!
show_en: They buy two tickets. A ticket is one hundred afghani. The bus is big and blue. Mina sits at the window. She is going to see the city for the first time!

say_en: How many tickets do they buy?
show_en: How many tickets do they buy?
wrong_say_fa: نه. آنها دو تکت می‌خرند: They buy two tickets.

say_en: Where does Mina sit?
show_en: Where does Mina sit?
wrong_say_fa: نه. مینا پیش کلکین می‌نشیند: Mina sits at the window.

intro_fa: متنی دربارهٔ کشور ما در سه صفحه: کوه‌ها، شهرها و قریه‌ها. به There is و There are نگاه کن.
say_en: Our country
show_en: Our country

say_en: Afghanistan is a country in Asia. There are high mountains, green valleys and dry deserts. There is no sea, but there are many rivers.
show_en: Afghanistan is a country in Asia. There are high mountains, green valleys and dry deserts. There is no sea, but there are many rivers.

say_en: Is there a sea in Afghanistan?
show_en: Is there a sea in Afghanistan?
wrong_say_fa: نه. دوباره بخوان: There is no sea. در افغانستان بحر نیست.

say_en: Kabul is a very big city. There are other cities, too: Herat, Mazar-i-Sharif, Kandahar and Jalalabad. Many people live in villages. They are farmers and shepherds.
show_en: Kabul is a very big city. There are other cities, too: Herat, Mazar-i-Sharif, Kandahar and Jalalabad. Many people live in villages. They are farmers and shepherds.

say_en: What kind of place is Kabul?
show_en: What kind of place is Kabul?
wrong_say_fa: نه. کابل یک شهر بسیار کلان است: Kabul is a very big city.

say_en: What do many people in the villages do?
show_en: What do many people in the villages do?
wrong_say_fa: نه. مردم قریه‌ها دهقان و چوپان هستند: They are farmers and shepherds.

say_en: In winter there is a lot of snow in the mountains. In spring the snow becomes water. The water runs down to the fields. That is good for the farmers.
show_en: In winter there is a lot of snow in the mountains. In spring the snow becomes water. The water runs down to the fields. That is good for the farmers.

say_en: Why is the snow good for the farmers?
show_en: Why is the snow good for the farmers?
choices: t:It is white|t:It gives water|t:It is cold
wrong_say_fa: نه. در بهار برف آب می‌شود و به زمین‌ها می‌رسد.

intro_fa: قصهٔ خرگوش و سنگ‌پشت در سه صفحه. به faster و slower نگاه کن. کی می‌بَرد و چرا؟
say_en: The rabbit and the tortoise
show_en: The rabbit and the tortoise

say_en: A rabbit and a tortoise lived near a field. The rabbit was faster than the tortoise. Every day it said: "You are slower than a stone!"
show_en: A rabbit and a tortoise lived near a field. The rabbit was faster than the tortoise. Every day it said: "You are slower than a stone!"

say_en: Who was faster?
show_en: Who was faster?
wrong_say_fa: نه. خرگوش از سنگ‌پشت تیزتر بود: The rabbit was faster.

say_en: One day the tortoise said: "Let us run to the big tree." The rabbit laughed and ran fast. Then it thought: "I am much faster. I can sleep a little."
show_en: One day the tortoise said: "Let us run to the big tree." The rabbit laughed and ran fast. Then it thought: "I am much faster. I can sleep a little."

say_en: What did the rabbit do on the way?
show_en: What did the rabbit do on the way?
wrong_say_fa: نه. خرگوش فکر کرد که بسیار تیزتر است و خوابید.

say_en: The tortoise walked and walked. It did not stop. When the rabbit woke up, the tortoise was at the tree! In the end the slower animal won.
show_en: The tortoise walked and walked. It did not stop. When the rabbit woke up, the tortoise was at the tree! In the end the slower animal won.

say_en: Who was at the tree first?
show_en: Who was at the tree first?
wrong_say_fa: نه. وقتی خرگوش بیدار شد، سنگ‌پشت پیش درخت بود.

say_en: Why did the tortoise win?
show_en: Why did the tortoise win?
choices: t:It was faster|t:It did not stop|t:It was bigger
wrong_say_fa: نه. سنگ‌پشت آهسته‌تر بود، اما ایستاد نشد: It did not stop.

intro_fa: این قصهٔ تکرار است: کار، پلان، سفر و مقایسه، همه با هم. فرید می‌خواهد مستری شود. سه صفحه بخوان.
say_en: Farid's plan
show_en: Farid's plan

say_en: Farid lives in a small village. His father is a farmer and his mother is a tailor. Farid is twelve. He is taller than his mother, and he is strong.
show_en: Farid lives in a small village. His father is a farmer and his mother is a tailor. Farid is twelve. He is taller than his mother, and he is strong.

say_en: What is his mother's job?
show_en: What is his mother's job?
wrong_say_fa: نه. دوباره بخوان: His mother is a tailor. مادرش خیاط است.

say_en: Farid wants to be a mechanic. He likes cars, lorries and tractors. Next summer he is going to work with his uncle. His uncle has a workshop in the city.
show_en: Farid wants to be a mechanic. He likes cars, lorries and tractors. Next summer he is going to work with his uncle. His uncle has a workshop in the city.

say_en: What does Farid want to be?
show_en: What does Farid want to be?
wrong_say_fa: نه. فرید می‌خواهد مستری شود: Farid wants to be a mechanic.

say_en: Where is he going to work?
show_en: Where is he going to work?
choices: t:in a workshop|t:in the field|t:in a shop
wrong_say_fa: نه. او در ورکشاپ کاکایش کار می‌کند: His uncle has a workshop.

say_en: The city is bigger than the village, and it is far. Farid is going to go there by bus. He is not afraid. He says: "I am going to learn a lot!"
show_en: The city is bigger than the village, and it is far. Farid is going to go there by bus. He is not afraid. He says: "I am going to learn a lot!"

say_en: How is he going to get to the city?
show_en: How is he going to get to the city?
wrong_say_fa: نه. فرید با بس می‌رود: by bus.

say_en: Which is bigger?
show_en: Which is bigger?
wrong_say_fa: نه. شهر از قریه کلانتر است: The city is bigger than the village.

say_en: Why is Farid going to go to the city?
show_en: Why is Farid going to go to the city?
wrong_say_fa: نه. فرید به شهر می‌رود که کار مستری را یاد بگیرد: I am going to learn a lot.

intro_fa: در بازار دو دکان بوت است. در سه صفحه بخوان که کدام کلانتر، کدام ارزانتر و کدام بهتر است. در آخر خودت تصمیم بگیر.
say_en: Two shops
show_en: Two shops

say_en: There are two shoe shops in the bazaar. The first shop is bigger. The shoes there are more beautiful, but they are more expensive.
show_en: There are two shoe shops in the bazaar. The first shop is bigger. The shoes there are more beautiful, but they are more expensive.

say_en: Where are the shoes more expensive?
show_en: Where are the shoes more expensive?
choices: t:in the big shop|t:in the small shop
wrong_say_fa: نه. دوباره بخوان: در دکان اول که کلانتر است، بوت‌ها گرانتر است.

say_en: The second shop is smaller and older. The shoes are cheaper. The shopkeeper says: "My shoes are better. They are stronger!"
show_en: The second shop is smaller and older. The shoes are cheaper. The shopkeeper says: "My shoes are better. They are stronger!"

say_en: What does the shopkeeper say about his shoes?
show_en: What does the shopkeeper say about his shoes?
choices: t:They are stronger|t:They are bigger|t:They are older
wrong_say_fa: نه. دکاندار گفت They are stronger: بوت‌های من محکم‌تر است.

say_en: Roya has three hundred afghani. In the big shop the shoes are five hundred afghani. In the small shop they are two hundred and fifty.
show_en: Roya has three hundred afghani. In the big shop the shoes are five hundred afghani. In the small shop they are two hundred and fifty.

say_en: Where can Roya buy her shoes?
show_en: Where can Roya buy her shoes?
choices: t:in the big shop|t:in the small shop
wrong_say_fa: نه. رویا سه‌صد افغانی دارد. بوت‌های دکان کلان پنجصد است و پول او نمی‌رسد.

say_en: Why can she buy them there?
show_en: Why can she buy them there?
choices: t:They are cheaper|t:They are red|t:They are new
wrong_say_fa: نه. در دکان خُرد بوت‌ها ارزانتر است: دوصد و پنجاه افغانی.

intro_fa: طفل شیرخور گریه می‌کند و نوید می‌پرسد که چرا. در سه صفحه بخوان و دلیل را پیدا کن.
say_en: Why does the baby cry?
show_en: Why does the baby cry?

say_en: The baby cries and cries. Navid asks: "Why does he cry? Is he hungry?" "No," says mother. "He drank his milk."
show_en: The baby cries and cries. Navid asks: "Why does he cry? Is he hungry?" "No," says mother. "He drank his milk."

say_en: Is the baby hungry?
show_en: Is the baby hungry?
wrong_say_fa: نه. مادر گفت He drank his milk: او شیر خود را نوشیده است.

say_en: "Is he cold?" "No. He has a warm blanket." "Is he afraid?" "No. We are here." Then grandmother comes. She looks at the baby.
show_en: "Is he cold?" "No. He has a warm blanket." "Is he afraid?" "No. We are here." Then grandmother comes. She looks at the baby.

say_en: Why is the baby not cold?
show_en: Why is the baby not cold?
choices: t:a warm blanket|t:a hot stove|t:a big coat
wrong_say_fa: نه. طفل یک کمپل گرم دارد: He has a warm blanket.

say_en: "I know why," she says. "He cries because he is tired. He wants to sleep." She sings a song. Now the baby is calm. He sleeps.
show_en: "I know why," she says. "He cries because he is tired. He wants to sleep." She sings a song. Now the baby is calm. He sleeps.

say_en: Why does the baby cry?
show_en: Why does the baby cry?
choices: t:He is tired|t:He is hungry|t:He is afraid
wrong_say_fa: نه. مادرکلان گفت He cries because he is tired: چون مانده است.

say_en: Who knows why the baby cries?
show_en: Who knows why the baby cries?
wrong_say_fa: نه. مادرکلان می‌داند: I know why, she says.

intro_fa: زرمینه می‌گوید که چرا می‌خواهد نرس شود. در سه صفحه بخوان. هر because یک دلیل است.
say_en: Why I want to be a nurse
show_en: Why I want to be a nurse

say_en: My name is Zarmina. When I grow up, I want to be a nurse. Why? Because last year my little brother was very sick.
show_en: My name is Zarmina. When I grow up, I want to be a nurse. Why? Because last year my little brother was very sick.

say_en: Who was very sick?
show_en: Who was very sick?
wrong_say_fa: نه. برادر خُرد زرمینه مریض بود: My little brother was very sick.

say_en: We took him to the clinic. The nurse was kind. She helped him day and night. After a week he was well.
show_en: We took him to the clinic. The nurse was kind. She helped him day and night. After a week he was well.

say_en: Who helped her brother?
show_en: Who helped her brother?
wrong_say_fa: نه. نرس شب و روز به او کمک کرد: The nurse helped him day and night.

say_en: I want to be a nurse because I want to help children like my brother. I am going to learn a lot because a nurse must know many things.
show_en: I want to be a nurse because I want to help children like my brother. I am going to learn a lot because a nurse must know many things.

say_en: Why does Zarmina want to be a nurse?
show_en: Why does Zarmina want to be a nurse?
choices: t:to help children|t:to see the city|t:to have money
wrong_say_fa: نه. او می‌خواهد به اطفال کمک کند: because I want to help children.

say_en: Why is she going to learn a lot?
show_en: Why is she going to learn a lot?
choices: t:She likes school|t:A nurse must know a lot|t:It is easy
right: t:A nurse must know a lot
wrong_say_fa: نه. نرس باید چیزهای بسیار بداند: A nurse must know many things.

intro_fa: قصهٔ یک روباه گرسنه در سه صفحه. به کلمه‌های قصه نگاه کن: One day، Then، Suddenly، Finally، In the end.
say_en: The fox and the grapes
show_en: The fox and the grapes

say_en: One day a hungry fox came to a garden. There were sweet grapes on the wall. The fox jumped, but the grapes were too high.
show_en: One day a hungry fox came to a garden. There were sweet grapes on the wall. The fox jumped, but the grapes were too high.

say_en: What did the fox want?
show_en: What did the fox want?
wrong_say_fa: نه. روباه انگور می‌خواست: There were sweet grapes on the wall.

say_en: Why could the fox not eat the grapes?
show_en: Why could the fox not eat the grapes?
choices: t:They were too high|t:They were bad|t:It was full
wrong_say_fa: نه. انگورها بسیار بلند بود و روباه به آنها نمی‌رسید.

say_en: Then it jumped again and again. Suddenly a dog came. It was bigger than the fox, and it was angry.
show_en: Then it jumped again and again. Suddenly a dog came. It was bigger than the fox, and it was angry.

say_en: Who came suddenly?
show_en: Who came suddenly?
wrong_say_fa: نه. ناگهان یک سگ آمد: Suddenly a dog came.

say_en: The fox ran away. Finally it stopped under a tree. "I did not want the grapes," it said. "They were not sweet!" In the end the fox was still hungry.
show_en: The fox ran away. Finally it stopped under a tree. "I did not want the grapes," it said. "They were not sweet!" In the end the fox was still hungry.

say_en: Was the fox still hungry in the end?
show_en: Was the fox still hungry in the end?
wrong_say_fa: بلی. روباه انگور نخورد. در آخر هنوز گرسنه بود.

intro_fa: قصهٔ زاغ تشنه و کوزه در سه صفحه. به said، asked و answered نگاه کن: کی چه گفت؟
say_en: The crow and the jug
show_en: The crow and the jug

say_en: One hot day a crow was very thirsty. It saw a jug. There was a little water in the jug, but the crow could not reach it.
show_en: One hot day a crow was very thirsty. It saw a jug. There was a little water in the jug, but the crow could not reach it.

say_en: Why could the crow not drink?
show_en: Why could the crow not drink?
choices: t:The water was low|t:The jug was hot|t:It was night
wrong_say_fa: نه. آب کم بود و در تهِ کوزه بود. نول زاغ به آن نمی‌رسید.

say_en: A pigeon came. "What are you going to do?" it asked. "I am going to think," said the crow. Then it saw some small stones.
show_en: A pigeon came. "What are you going to do?" it asked. "I am going to think," said the crow. Then it saw some small stones.

say_en: Who asked: What are you going to do?
show_en: Who asked: What are you going to do?
wrong_say_fa: نه. کبوتر پرسید: it asked.

say_en: The crow dropped the stones into the jug, one by one. The water came up. "Now I can drink!" said the crow. "You are clever," answered the pigeon.
show_en: The crow dropped the stones into the jug, one by one. The water came up. "Now I can drink!" said the crow. "You are clever," answered the pigeon.

say_en: What did the crow drop into the jug?
show_en: What did the crow drop into the jug?
wrong_say_fa: نه. زاغ سنگچه‌ها را یکی یکی در کوزه انداخت.

say_en: What did the pigeon answer?
show_en: What did the pigeon answer?
choices: t:You are clever|t:You are slow|t:Go away
wrong_say_fa: نه. کبوتر جواب داد You are clever: تو هوشیار هستی.

intro_fa: قصهٔ قدیمی دو بز روی پل، در سه صفحه. در میان قصه خودت تصمیم بگیر که بزها چه کنند.
say_en: Two goats on the bridge
show_en: Two goats on the bridge

say_en: Two goats lived on two sides of a river. There was a small bridge over the water. Only one goat could cross at a time.
show_en: Two goats lived on two sides of a river. There was a small bridge over the water. Only one goat could cross at a time.

say_en: One day the two goats met in the middle of the bridge. "Go back!" said the white goat. "I am stronger." "No, you go back," said the black goat. "I am older."
show_en: One day the two goats met in the middle of the bridge. "Go back!" said the white goat. "I am stronger." "No, you go back," said the black goat. "I am older."

say_en: What should the goats do?
show_en: What should the goats do?
wrong_say_fa: نه. پل خُرد است. اگر هر دو زور بزنند، هر دو می‌افتند. بهتر است که یکی پس برود.

say_en: They pushed and pushed. Suddenly both goats fell into the cold water! They were strong, but they were not clever.
show_en: They pushed and pushed. Suddenly both goats fell into the cold water! They were strong, but they were not clever.

say_en: Where did the goats fall?
show_en: Where did the goats fall?
choices: t:into the water|t:into a net|t:on the road
wrong_say_fa: نه. هر دو بز در آب سرد افتادند: into the cold water.

say_en: Why did the goats fall?
show_en: Why did the goats fall?
choices: t:The bridge was old|t:They pushed|t:It rained
wrong_say_fa: نه. آنها یکدیگر را تیله کردند و هیچ کدام پس نرفت.

say_en: What were the goats not?
show_en: What were the goats not?
wrong_say_fa: نه. آنها قوی بودند، اما هوشیار نبودند: They were not clever.

intro_fa: این یک خط است که فرید از کابل برای برادرش نوشته است. سه صفحه بخوان. اول Dear، در آخر From.
say_en: A letter from Kabul
show_en: A letter from Kabul

say_en: Dear Omar, How are you? I am fine. I am in Kabul now. I work in my uncle's workshop. Kabul is bigger than our village, and it is louder.
show_en: Dear Omar, How are you? I am fine. I am in Kabul now. I work in my uncle's workshop. Kabul is bigger than our village, and it is louder.

say_en: Where is Farid now?
show_en: Where is Farid now?
wrong_say_fa: نه. فرید نوشت I am in Kabul now: حالا در کابل است.

say_en: I learn a lot here. Yesterday I repaired a motorbike! In the evening I learn English because I want to read books about cars.
show_en: I learn a lot here. Yesterday I repaired a motorbike! In the evening I learn English because I want to read books about cars.

say_en: What did Farid repair?
show_en: What did Farid repair?
wrong_say_fa: نه. دیروز یک موترسایکل را ترمیم کرد: I repaired a motorbike.

say_en: Why does he learn English?
show_en: Why does he learn English?
choices: t:to read books|t:to buy a car|t:to go home
wrong_say_fa: نه. او می‌خواهد کتاب‌هایی دربارهٔ موتر بخواند: because I want to read books about cars.

say_en: I am going to come home in spring. I am going to bring you a present. Please write to me soon. From your brother, Farid.
show_en: I am going to come home in spring. I am going to bring you a present. Please write to me soon. From your brother, Farid.

say_en: When is he going to come home?
show_en: When is he going to come home?
wrong_say_fa: نه. فرید در بهار به خانه می‌آید: I am going to come home in spring.

say_en: Who wrote the letter?
show_en: Who wrote the letter?
wrong_say_fa: نه. در آخر خط نوشته است From your brother, Farid: از طرف برادرت فرید.

intro_fa: سه پیام کوتاه بین دو دوست: دعوت، معذرت و جواب مهربان. هر پیام یک صفحه است.
say_en: Three messages
show_en: Three messages

say_en: Dear Shirin, On Friday my sister is going to come home from Kabul. We are going to cook a big dinner. Please come to our house at six o'clock. From Nargis.
show_en: Dear Shirin, On Friday my sister is going to come home from Kabul. We are going to cook a big dinner. Please come to our house at six o'clock. From Nargis.

say_en: What is this message?
show_en: What is this message?
wrong_say_fa: نه. نرگس شیرین را دعوت می‌کند: Please come to our house.

say_en: Dear Nargis, Thank you for your message. I am sorry, I can't come on Friday because my mother is sick. I must help her at home. From Shirin.
show_en: Dear Nargis, Thank you for your message. I am sorry, I can't come on Friday because my mother is sick. I must help her at home. From Shirin.

say_en: Why can't Shirin come?
show_en: Why can't Shirin come?
choices: t:Her mother is sick|t:She is in Kabul|t:It is too far
wrong_say_fa: نه. شیرین نوشت because my mother is sick: چون مادرش مریض است.

say_en: Dear Shirin, I am sorry about your mother. I am going to bring you some food on Saturday. I hope she is going to be well soon. From Nargis.
show_en: Dear Shirin, I am sorry about your mother. I am going to bring you some food on Saturday. I hope she is going to be well soon. From Nargis.

say_en: What is Nargis going to bring?
show_en: What is Nargis going to bring?
wrong_say_fa: نه. نرگس روز شنبه برای آنها خوراک می‌آورد: some food.

say_en: Who wrote the last message?
show_en: Who wrote the last message?
wrong_say_fa: نه. در آخر پیام نوشته است From Nargis.

intro_fa: رویا از آیندهٔ خود می‌نویسد: چه می‌خواهد شود، کجا درس می‌خواند و چرا. سه صفحه بخوان.
say_en: My future
show_en: My future

say_en: My name is Roya. I am thirteen. I live in a small village in the mountains. In my village there is a school, but there is no clinic.
show_en: My name is Roya. I am thirteen. I live in a small village in the mountains. In my village there is a school, but there is no clinic.

say_en: What is there not in her village?
show_en: What is there not in her village?
wrong_say_fa: نه. دوباره بخوان: There is a school, but there is no clinic. در قریه کلینیک نیست.

say_en: The clinic is far. Sick people must walk three hours. That is why I want to be a doctor.
show_en: The clinic is far. Sick people must walk three hours. That is why I want to be a doctor.

say_en: Why does Roya want to be a doctor?
show_en: Why does Roya want to be a doctor?
choices: t:The clinic is far|t:She likes the city|t:It is easy
wrong_say_fa: نه. کلینیک دور است و مردم مریض باید سه ساعت پیاده بروند.

say_en: I am going to study in the city because there is a university. It is going to be difficult, but I am not afraid. Then I am going to come back and work in my village.
show_en: I am going to study in the city because there is a university. It is going to be difficult, but I am not afraid. Then I am going to come back and work in my village.

say_en: Where is she going to study?
show_en: Where is she going to study?
choices: t:in the village|t:in the city|t:at home
wrong_say_fa: نه. او در شهر درس می‌خواند چون در آنجا پوهنتون است.

say_en: What is she going to do after that?
show_en: What is she going to do after that?
choices: t:stay in the city|t:come back|t:buy a car
wrong_say_fa: نه. او پس می‌آید و در قریهٔ خود کار می‌کند.

intro_fa: این قصهٔ آخر است، در چهار صفحه: یک قصه با دلیل‌ها، مقایسه و در آخر یک پیام. یوسف پسر چوپان است.
say_en: The lost lamb
show_en: The lost lamb

say_en: One day Yusuf, the shepherd's son, took the sheep to the hill. In the evening he counted them. One lamb was not there!
show_en: One day Yusuf, the shepherd's son, took the sheep to the hill. In the evening he counted them. One lamb was not there!

say_en: What was not there?
show_en: What was not there?
wrong_say_fa: نه. دوباره بخوان: One lamb was not there. یک بره نبود.

say_en: Yusuf was worried because the night was coming. "I am going to find it," he said. He walked up the hill. It was darker and colder now.
show_en: Yusuf was worried because the night was coming. "I am going to find it," he said. He walked up the hill. It was darker and colder now.

say_en: Why was Yusuf worried?
show_en: Why was Yusuf worried?
choices: t:Night was coming|t:He was hungry|t:It rained
wrong_say_fa: نه. یوسف پریشان بود چون شب نزدیک می‌شد: because the night was coming.

say_en: Suddenly he heard a small voice. The lamb was behind a big stone. It was afraid. Yusuf carried it home. His father said: "You are braver than me!"
show_en: Suddenly he heard a small voice. The lamb was behind a big stone. It was afraid. Yusuf carried it home. His father said: "You are braver than me!"

say_en: Where was the lamb?
show_en: Where was the lamb?
choices: t:behind a stone|t:in the river|t:at home
wrong_say_fa: نه. بره پشت یک سنگ کلان بود: behind a big stone.

say_en: What did his father say?
show_en: What did his father say?
choices: t:You are late|t:You are braver|t:Go to bed
wrong_say_fa: نه. پدرش گفت You are braver than me: تو از من دلیرتر هستی.

say_en: Yusuf's message
show_en: Yusuf's message

say_en: The next day Yusuf wrote a message: "Dear uncle, yesterday I found our lamb at night. I am going to be a good shepherd. From Yusuf."
show_en: The next day Yusuf wrote a message: "Dear uncle, yesterday I found our lamb at night. I am going to be a good shepherd. From Yusuf."

say_en: Who is the message for?
show_en: Who is the message for?
wrong_say_fa: نه. پیام با Dear uncle شروع می‌شود: برای کاکایش است.

say_en: What is Yusuf going to be?
show_en: What is Yusuf going to be?
wrong_say_fa: نه. یوسف نوشت I am going to be a good shepherd: یک چوپان خوب می‌شود.
